summary: Recent updates in the compositing and layers area of Firefox have streamlined several processes that contribute to graphics rendering, particularly on Android and in multi-process contexts. A key change involves enhancements to **_AndroidImageReader_**, which is crucial for handling images efficiently in video playback and rendering by supporting new formats and improving error handling. Additionally, adjustments to the **_Async Pan/Zoom (APZ)_** mechanism enhance smooth scrolling experiences by better synchronizing scrolling actions, ensuring a more responsive interface, especially on touch devices. Overall, these changes aim to enhance performance and reliability, resulting in a smoother user experience when interacting with graphics-intensive content.
